---
name: Missing achievement
about: An achievement was unlocked in the game but did not show up
title: ''
labels: missing achievement
assignees: ''

---

**Game**
Name of the game and where you got it (Steam, Ubisoft, Epic, GOG, EA).

**Crack or emulator**
Which one the game uses, if you know it (for example Goldberg, OnlineFix, RUNE, LumaPlay, Nemirtingas, UniverseLAN, anadius).

**What happened**
Which achievement you unlocked, about when, and what Achievement Watcher showed (no popup, wrong name, not in the list).

**Report**
If the game shows up in Achievement Watcher, open it, click **See all achievements**, then **Missing an achievement?** at the bottom, and attach the zip it saves to your Downloads folder. It contains the achievement files the app reads for that game, what it found in them, and the recent log.

If the game does not show up at all, go to Settings > About > Diagnostics, click **Export diagnostics** and attach that zip instead.
